启动前按规定摆好机身与四肢，并确认关节状态正常。完成电源操作后等待初始化，本机会: Position the body and legs as specified and check that the joints are in normal condition. After pressing the power button, allow initialization to finish; this robot stands up automatically.
结合实验室操作记录与宇树 Go2 用户手册。: Based on lab operating notes and the Unitree Go2 user manual.
放在平整地面，腹部支撑垫贴地，机身保持水平。小腿完全收拢，四腿关节与足端平放，避: Place the robot on level ground with its abdominal support pad touching the ground and its body horizontal. Fully fold the lower legs and rest all leg joints and feet flat. Keep the body from resting on the thighs or shins, and check that all joints are in normal condition.
短按后接长按电源键: Short press, then hold the power button
先短按一下，再长按至少 2 秒。本机可听到关节与风扇启动声；声音响起表示启动已开: Press once briefly, then hold for at least 2 seconds. On this unit, the joints and fans become audible as startup begins. Continue waiting after you hear them.
本机启动后会自动站起来。宇树手册给出的参考等待时间约为 2 分钟，正常启动时头部: This robot stands up automatically after startup. Unitree gives an approximate wait of 2 minutes. During normal startup, the head indicator changes from flashing green to steady green and the body remains level. Use the actual robot state as the reference.
宇树《Go2 用户手册》明确要求按规定姿态开机，并在开机失败时先检查摆放姿态。上: The Unitree Go2 user manual specifies the startup posture and says to check it first if startup fails. The positioning instructions above follow that manual.
